# Breakage Report: `thingsboard_pe_client` 4.2.1 → 4.4.0 (autogenerated)

**Date:** 2026-06-03
**Method:** Compiler-driven. The app was pointed at the new client via a local path
dependency on a throwaway branch (`chore/eval-new-client-4.4.0`), the single package
re-export was renamed (`thingsboard_client.dart` → `thingsboard_pe_client.dart`), and
`flutter analyze` was captured as ground truth (`/tmp/new-client-analyze.txt`). No app
code was changed permanently; the branch was discarded. The analyzer error set is
exhaustive by construction — every breakage below traces to a real `file:line:col`.

> **Scope note.** This report covers *compile-time* breakage only. Calls that still
> compile but may behave differently at runtime (serialization, nullability, enum
> fallback) are listed under "Residual runtime risks" for a later, post-migration
> verification phase — they are deliberately out of scope here.

---

## Executive summary

`thingsboard_pe_client` keeps its **name** across versions but **not its architecture**.
v4.2.1 is hand-written (semantic services like `getDeviceService()`, generic
`PageData<T>`, mutable `fromJson`/`toJson` models). v4.4.0 is **OpenAPI-autogenerated**:
per-controller API classes (`getDeviceControllerApi()`), Dio `Response<T>` return
wrappers, and immutable `built_value` models with all-nullable fields. A handwritten
`common/` runtime (auth, websocket, storage, errors) is preserved.

**This is a port of the data-access layer, not a version bump.**

- **817 analyzer issues, 629 errors** across **~70 files**.
- Errors by area: `core` 175 (auth 159), `utils` 138 (services 131), `modules` 311
  (alarm 89, main/navigation 76, device 64, asset 23, profile 19, audit_log 18,
  notification 13), `config` 5.
- **Preserved / drop-in (verified ~0 errors):** the `ThingsboardClient(...)` constructor
  + callbacks, the auth/session surface, `TbStorage`, `ThingsboardError`, and the entire
  WebSocket/`TelemetrySubscriber` telemetry stack.
- **No missing *server* functionality (corrected after a second, deeper pass).** Symbols
  that first looked absent are actually present under autogenerated names, reachable via
  renamed types or different calling conventions. The only genuinely-absent items are a
  few small **client-side helper types** that were never REST DTOs — the app can vendor
  them (copy the files in). See §D for the full mapping; nothing requires a server/spec
  change.

**Recommendation:** treat this as a scoped but **purely mechanical** migration — no
blocking product/API decisions. Order of work: (1) vendor the 2–3 client-side helpers
(§D), (2) mechanically port the service→controller call sites and rename the handful of
renamed types, (3) rebuild the `built_value` model usages, (4) run a post-migration
runtime diff for the serialization risks.

| Count | Rule | What it means here |
|------:|------|--------------------|
| 129 | `undefined_method` | Service accessors (`getAlarmService()` …) and model helpers (`EntityData.field()`, enum `toShortString()`) gone |
| 105 | `undefined_identifier` | Missing types/enums referenced by name (`Pages` 62, `SignUpFieldsId` 40 …) |
| 77 | `undefined_named_parameter` | `built_value` model constructors take different/named params than the old hand-written ones |
| 74 | `argument_type_not_assignable` | Old model types vs new `built_value` types; `Response<T>` vs `T` |
| 42 | `unchecked_use_of_nullable_value` | New models are all-nullable; old code assumed non-null |
| 38 | `undefined_getter` | Model field access changed/renamed |
| 28 | `non_type_as_type_argument` | Missing classes used as generics (e.g. `PageData<MissingType>`) |
| 24 | `undefined_class` | `UsersAssignQuery`, `VersionInfo`, `PageLayout`, `PlatformVersion`, `MobileBasicInfo` … |
| 23 | `assignment_to_final_no_setter` | `built_value` models are immutable; old code mutated fields directly |
| 20 | `creation_with_non_type` | Constructing now-missing classes |
| 18 | `const_constructor_param_type_mismatch` | Enum/const usage against `built_value` enums |
| 13 | `invalid_constant` | Same root cause as above |
| 12 | `undefined_operator` | Indexing/operators on changed model types |
| 6 | `non_exhaustive_switch_expression` | `built_value` enums add an `unknownDefaultOpenApi` fallback value |
| <5 each | `undefined_function`, `ambiguous_import`, `invalid_assignment`, `extra_positional_arguments`, `body_might_complete_normally`, `type_argument_not_matching_bounds`, return-type mismatches | Assorted knock-on effects |

## Breakage matrix (by category)

### A. Service accessor → controller API  *(change type: `accessor-renamed`)*
Every `tbClient.getXxxService()` is gone except `getTelemetryService()`. Each becomes a
`getXxxControllerApi()` returning Dio `Response<T>` (must `.data`-unwrap) of `built_value`
models. Confirmed missing accessors and their call counts:

| Old accessor | Occurrences | New equivalent | Note |
|--------------|-------------|----------------|------|
| `getTwoFactorAuthService` | 15 | `getTwoFactorAuthControllerApi` | `checkTwoFaVerificationCode` also moved off `ThingsboardClient` into the controller |
| `getAlarmService` | 13 | `getAlarmControllerApi` (+ `getAlarmCommentControllerApi`) | comments split into their own controller |
| `getUserService` | 10 | `getUserControllerApi` | |
| `getNotificationService` | 5 | `getNotificationControllerApi` | |
| `getSignupService` | 4 | `getSignUpControllerApi` (`sign_up_controller_api.dart`) | |
| `getTenantService` | 3 | `getTenantControllerApi` | |
| `getMobileService` | 3 | `getMobileAppControllerApi` (shape differs) | verify operationIds |
| `getDeviceService` | 3 | `getDeviceControllerApi` | |
| `getDashboardService` | 3 | `getDashboardControllerApi` | |
| `getAssetService` | 3 | `getAssetControllerApi` | |
| `getCustomerService` | 2 | `getCustomerControllerApi` | |
| `getDeviceProfileService` | 2 | `getDeviceProfileControllerApi` | |
| `getEntityQueryService` | 2 | `getEntityQueryControllerApi` | see §C (query objects) |
| `getWhiteLabelingService` | 2 | `getWhiteLabelingControllerApi` | |
| `getUserPermissionsService` | 2 | `getUserPermissionsControllerApi` | |
| `getSelfRegistrationService` | 2 | `getSelfRegistrationControllerApi` | |
| `getPlatformVersion` | 2 | **vendor (client-side)** | small version helper, not a REST call — see §D |
| `reInit` | 1 | **no direct equivalent** on `ThingsboardClient` | app uses it to switch endpoint at runtime — recreate the client (or add an endpoint setter); the only client-lifecycle gap |
| `sendResetPasswordLink` | 1 | moved into an auth/sign-up controller | verify operationId |

Representative call sites: `lib/core/auth/login/provider/login_provider.dart`,
`lib/modules/alarm/data/datasource/**`, `lib/utils/services/notification_service.dart`,
`lib/core/context/tb_context.dart`.

### B. Model shape: immutable `built_value`, all-nullable  *(change types: `model-shape`, `unchecked_use_of_nullable_value`, `assignment_to_final_no_setter`, `undefined_getter`, `undefined_named_parameter`)*
- **Immutability:** 23 `assignment_to_final_no_setter` — old code mutates model fields
  in place (e.g. building up a `User`/`Device` before save). With `built_value` these must
  be rebuilt via the generated `Builder`/`rebuild((b) => …)` pattern.
- **Nullability:** 42 `unchecked_use_of_nullable_value` + many `argument_type_not_assignable`
  — every field is `T?`. Code that read non-null fields now needs null handling.
- **Constructors:** 77 `undefined_named_parameter` — `built_value` factories differ from
  the old positional/named constructors; e.g. `AlarmComment(...)`, query objects.
- **Enum helpers gone:** `toShortString()` on `TwoFaProviderType`/`SignUpFieldId`/
  `PlatformType`, and `toColor()` on `AlarmSeverity`, are no longer defined — `built_value`
  enums expose `.name`/`wireName` and add an `unknownDefaultOpenApi` fallback (drives the
  6 `non_exhaustive_switch_expression` errors — switches must handle the fallback).

### C. Entity-query / telemetry-data helpers  *(change type: `method-renamed` / `model-shape`)*
`lib/utils/services/entity_query_api.dart` (46 errors) is the densest single file:
- `EntityData.field(...)` (17×) and `EntityData.attribute(...)` (3×) helper accessors are
  gone — the `built_value` `EntityData` exposes raw maps; the app's convenience extractors
  must be reimplemented.
- `EntityDataQuery.next()` paging helper gone.
- The query builder objects (`EntityDataQuery`, `EntityCountQuery`, `KeyFilter`,
  `EntityKey`, filter predicates) compile against different constructors.

> Note: the **websocket** telemetry path (`TelemetrySubscriber`, subscription cmds) is
> *preserved* (§ Drop-in). The breakage here is specifically the **REST** entity-query
> helper layer, not realtime subscriptions.

### D. "Missing" symbols — resolved (corrected mapping)  *(change types: `renamed`, `query→params`, `vendor`)*
A second deeper pass (searching `common/` + `pe/`, looser patterns, and reading the files)
found that **almost nothing is actually missing** — the symbols exist under autogenerated
names or different calling conventions. Verified mapping:

| Old symbol | Errors | Status | New equivalent / action |
|------------|-------:|--------|--------------------------|
| `SignUpFieldsId` | 40 | **renamed** | `SignUpFieldId` (built_value `EnumClass`, `pe/lib/src/model/sign_up_field_id.dart`); replace `.toShortString()` with `.name`/wireName |
| `PageLayout` | ~7 | **renamed** | `MobileLayoutConfig` (+ `MobilePage` family) |
| `MobileBasicInfo` | ~1 | **renamed** | `UserMobileInfo` / `LoginMobileInfo` (`versionInfo`/`pages` become nested fields/sub-models) |
| `UsersAssignQuery` | ~11 | **query→params** | No wrapper class; call `getUserControllerApi().getUsersForAssign(alarmId: …, pageSize: …, page: …, textSearch: …)` → `PageData<UserEmailInfo>`. The old query object's fields are now method params. |
| `Pages` (enum: home/alarms/devices/…) | 62 | **vendor (client-side)** | A 9-value *app-navigation* enum — never a server DTO. The new `MobilePageType` (`DEFAULT/DASHBOARD/WEB_VIEW/CUSTOM`) is a different, server-driven concept. Define this enum inside the app. |
| `PlatformVersion` / `PlatformVersionMatcher` | ~7 | **vendor (client-side)** | Hand-written version-comparison helpers in 4.2.1, not REST DTOs. Copy the two small files into the app. (`VersionInfo` itself arrives as a field on `UserMobileInfo`.) |

So the only truly-absent items are **client-side helpers** (`Pages`, `PlatformVersion`/
`PlatformVersionMatcher`) — a few dozen trivial lines to vendor. Everything else is a
rename or a query-object→method-params change.

`ClaimResponse` was already absent in 4.2.1 (so 2 `ClaimResponse` errors are pre-existing
app-vs-client drift, unrelated to this migration).

---

## Drop-in-safe inventory (verified ~0 analyzer errors)

These produced no breakage and can migrate untouched:

- **Client construction:** `ThingsboardClient(endpoint, storage, onUserLoaded, onError,
  onLoadStarted, onLoadFinished, computeFunc)` and the callback types — identical signature.
- **Auth/session:** `login`, `logout`, `getAuthUser`, `isAuthenticated`,
  `setUserFromJwtToken`, `getJwtToken`, `isPreVerificationToken`, `isMfaConfigurationToken`.
- **Storage:** `TbStorage` interface (the app's `TbSecureStorage` implementation is fine).
- **Errors:** `ThingsboardError` + `ThingsBoardErrorCode`.
- **WebSocket / telemetry:** `getTelemetryService()`, `TelemetrySubscriber`,
  `createEntityAttributesSubscription`, `createNotificationsSubscription`,
  `createNotificationCountSubscription`, `EntityDataCmd`, `AlarmDataCmd`. (Preserved
  handwritten code in `common/`.)
- **Import chokepoint:** the app routes all client imports through
  `lib/thingsboard_client.dart`. Only the barrel name changes
  (`thingsboard_client.dart` → `thingsboard_pe_client.dart`) — a one-line edit, not 193.

---

## Residual runtime risks (out of scope — verify post-migration)

Once the app compiles against 4.4.0, these will NOT be caught by the compiler and need a
scoped automated diff against a dev ThingsBoard server (not manual click-through):

1. **`built_value` silently-null fields** — server-populated fields that the new model
   marks nullable may read as `null` where the old model guaranteed a value.
2. **Enum `unknownDefaultOpenApi` fallback** — unrecognized server enum values map to the
   fallback instead of throwing; verify UI handles it.
3. **`Response<T>` unwrapping** — confirm `.data` is non-null on success paths and error
   mapping still routes through `ThingsboardError`.
4. **Query-object JSON shape** — `EntityDataQuery`, `AlarmQueryV2`, `EntityCountQuery`
   serialize via `built_value`; diff the emitted request bodies against 4.2.1 for the
   alarm list, device list, and entity-count flows.

## How to reproduce

```bash
git checkout -b chore/eval-new-client-4.4.0
# pubspec.yaml: thingsboard_pe_client: { path: ../thingsboard-dart-client/pe }
flutter pub get
# lib/thingsboard_client.dart: export '.../thingsboard_pe_client.dart';
flutter analyze > /tmp/new-client-analyze.txt 2>&1   # 817 issues, 629 errors
git checkout master && git branch -D chore/eval-new-client-4.4.0
```

## Appendix: verified alarm-module mappings (prototype)

The alarm module was chosen as the prototype. Every call its datasources make was
re-implemented against the new controllers in a standalone PoC
(`thingsboard-dart-client/pe/example/alarm_migration_poc.dart`) and **`dart analyze`
returns `No issues found!`** — so these mappings are type-verified, not inferred.

| Old call (`getXxxService()`) | Returns (old) | New call | Returns (new) | Notes |
|------------------------------|---------------|----------|---------------|-------|
| `getAlarmService().getAllAlarmsV2(AlarmQueryV2)` | `PageData<AlarmInfo>` | `getAlarmControllerApi().getAllAlarmsV2(pageSize, page, statusList, severityList, typeList, assigneeId, startTime, endTime, sortProperty, sortOrder)` | `Response<PageDataAlarmInfo>` | query object → flat params; lists are `BuiltList<String>` |
| `getAlarmService().getAlarmInfo(id)` | `AlarmInfo?` | `getAlarmControllerApi().getAlarmInfoById(alarmId:)` | `Response<AlarmInfo>` | |
| `getAlarmService().getAlarmTypes(PageLink)` | `PageData<AlarmType>` | `getAlarmControllerApi().getAlarmTypes(pageSize, page, textSearch)` | `Response<PageDataEntitySubtype>` | type changed: `AlarmType` → `EntitySubtype` |
| `getAlarmService().ackAlarm(id)` | `AlarmInfo` | `getAlarmControllerApi().ackAlarm(alarmId:)` | `Response<AlarmInfo>` | |
| `getAlarmService().clearAlarm(id)` | `AlarmInfo` | `getAlarmControllerApi().clearAlarm(alarmId:)` | `Response<AlarmInfo>` | |
| `getAlarmService().assignAlarm(id, assigneeId)` | `AlarmInfo` | `getAlarmControllerApi().assignAlarm(alarmId:, assigneeId:)` | `Response<Alarm>` | **return type shift** `AlarmInfo`→`Alarm` |
| `getAlarmService().unassignAlarm(id)` | `AlarmInfo` | `getAlarmControllerApi().unassignAlarm(alarmId:)` | `Response<Alarm>` | **return type shift** |
| `getAlarmService().getAlarmComments(AlarmCommentsQuery)` | `PageData<AlarmCommentInfo>` | `getAlarmCommentControllerApi().getAlarmComments(alarmId, pageSize, page, sortProperty, sortOrder)` | `Response<PageDataAlarmCommentInfo>` | moved to comment controller |
| `getAlarmService().postAlarmComment(AlarmComment(...))` | `AlarmCommentInfo` | `getAlarmCommentControllerApi().saveAlarmComment(alarmId:, alarmComment:)` | `Response<AlarmComment>` | **return shift**; body field `data`→`comment` (`JsonObject`); built via `AlarmComment((b) => …)` |
| `getAlarmService().deleteAlarmComment(commentId, alarmId:)` | `void` | `getAlarmCommentControllerApi().deleteAlarmComment(alarmId:, commentId:)` | `Response<void>` | |
| `getUserService().getUsersAssign(UsersAssignQuery)` | `PageData<UserInfo>` | `getUserControllerApi().getUsersForAssign(alarmId, pageSize, page, textSearch)` | `Response<PageDataUserEmailInfo>` | **return shift** `UserInfo`→`UserEmailInfo`; query object → params |
| `getUserService().getUsersInfo(PageLink)` | `PageData<UserInfo>` | `getUserControllerApi().getAllUserInfos(pageSize, page, textSearch)` | `Response<PageDataUserInfo>` | |

### Recommended migration architecture (validated by the prototype)
- **Datasource = adapter boundary.** Keep the app's pagination framework and its query
  objects (`AlarmQueryV2`, `UsersAssignQuery`) as **app-side DTOs**; decompose them into
  flat params *inside the datasource*. Blocs, usecases, and widgets stay untouched.
- **Map new `built_value` models → app domain entities at the datasource**, so the
  autogenerated types don't leak upward. This also absorbs the return-type shifts
  (`Alarm` vs `AlarmInfo`, `UserEmailInfo` vs `UserInfo`, `AlarmComment` vs
  `AlarmCommentInfo`) in one place.
- **`.data!` unwrap + error mapping** live in the datasource (or a thin shared helper).
